subject.title: build(deps): bump the actions group across 1 directory with 13 updates

question: Should the repository accept these 13 new executable Action revisions together after an exact-head rebase and successful affected-workflow checks?
rationale: The patch is mechanically clean, but it changes code executed with repository tokens, API keys, security-event permissions, and publishing credentials; accepting that supply-chain delta requires owner intent rather than automated correctness judgment.

options.title: Approve after exact-head gates
options.body: Rebase the PR, require the affected security, Docker, token, Codex-agent, and workflow-sanity checks to pass, then approve the immutable pins as one coordinated update.

options.title: Split sensitive action families
options.body: Separate Codex, token-minting, CodeQL, and Docker publishing actions into smaller PRs if any owner needs independent rollout or validation.

options.title: Hold current pins
options.body: Pause the update until Dependabot access is restored or owners can validate the executable revisions against current main.

recommendation.title: Approve after exact-head gates
recommendation.body: Rebase the PR, require the affected security, Docker, token, Codex-agent, and workflow-sanity checks to pass, then approve the immutable pins as one coordinated update.

likelyOwner.reason: The strongest available history signal spans the central CI, Docker release, action-runtime modernization, and Codex Docs Agent workflows affected here.
